statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is at the top of the watch band while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains WATCH. Overnight Nasdaq futures have softened, but higher Tail bands require verified persistent directional extension, weak retracements and broader current confirmation.
headline: Overnight Nasdaq futures soften while oil rises, but directional confirmation remains mixed
body: Delayed Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures were 29,423.75 at 01:08 UTC, down 0.23% and trading inside a narrow 29,410.75-29,435.50 overnight range. Reuters reported Brent at $91.05 as U.S.-Iran fighting renewed supply fears. Fresh supplementary context remained mixed across index futures and technology groups, so persistent one-way Nasdaq structure was not yet verified.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 20% to 30%. It was elevated at 01:00, 02:00 and 08:00 UTC on August 31, then remained in WATCH through 00:00 UTC on September 1. Stress stayed extreme at 97-99%, and the dominant mode shifted from event/whipsaw to mixed at 21:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail remains within WATCH through the next 24 hours, peaking around the 13:00-15:15 UTC danger window spanning Barr's remarks, the U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC JOLTS/ISM/Construction Spending cluster. Event importance keeps Stress high; Tail elevation still requires observed directional efficiency and weak retracements.

forecast.analysis: Delayed MNQ at 01:08 UTC was 29,423.75, down 0.23%, inside a 29,410.75-29,435.50 overnight range. The decline raises Tail to the top of WATCH, but the small range and conflicting cross-asset context do not establish persistent one-way structure.
drivers: Fresh delayed MNQ is lower but not pinned at the overnight extreme
Brent above $91 keeps inflation/geopolitical stress elevated
Fresh Finviz context shows positive semiconductors and mixed index futures

news.title: Oil prices rise as latest fighting resurrects Middle East supply disruption risks

forecast.analysis: If early-Asia trade absorbs the initial overnight drop and continues to rotate within the range, conditional Tail eases slightly. A fresh low followed by only shallow rebounds would instead strengthen evidence of mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Early-Asia range acceptance versus fresh-low extension
Oil shock remains a persistent stress amplifier

forecast.analysis: Conditional Tail falls further if Asia continues two-sided price discovery. Repeated downside extension after failed retracements would invalidate that easing even without a new scheduled catalyst.
drivers: Quality of pullbacks after any new overnight low

forecast.analysis: During mid-Asia, overlapping ranges and meaningful retracements would keep Tail contained. A held extreme with successive shallow pullbacks would shift the path back toward the upper WATCH band.
Late-Asia remains lower Tail if the overnight range stays overlapping. Oil and rates become stronger Tail amplifiers only if Nasdaq futures begin extending directionally while retracements fail.
drivers: Conditional alignment of oil, rates and Nasdaq direction

forecast.analysis: The Europe handoff raises conditional Tail modestly because a durable breakout can improve directional efficiency. Range re-entry after the handoff would argue against escalation.
At the European open, Tail remains WATCH unless overnight direction broadens across equity futures and rates with weak pullbacks. Failed continuation would keep the structure mixed.
Early European trade stays WATCH if price rotates around the overnight range. A sustained move away from that range with failed retracements would be the main conditional Tail escalation signal.

With the U.S. catalyst cluster still several hours away, conditional Tail remains moderate within WATCH. The key checkpoint is whether Europe creates a persistent directional sequence before U.S. participation deepens.
drivers: Distance to the U.S. event window

forecast.analysis: As U.S. premarket liquidity increases, conditional Tail edges higher. A widening gap plus synchronized rates, oil and technology weakness would matter more than the scheduled events by themselves.

Premarket Tail remains WATCH while markets position for the afternoon event cluster. Meaningful retracements would keep risk contained; repeated extension into the event window would raise path concern.
drivers: Retracement quality before major U.S. releases

forecast.analysis: Approaching the U.S. cash session, conditional Tail reaches the upper WATCH band. Barr's scheduled remarks and the nearby open raise Stress, while a Tail block still requires observed directional efficiency rather than event importance alone.
drivers: Fed Governor Barr scheduled at 13:05 UTC
Event importance raises Stress before it proves Tail

forecast.analysis: This hour contains Barr's 13:05 UTC remarks and the 13:30 UTC cash open. Tail remains at WATCH conditionally; persistent opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the adverse path checkpoint.

JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending are scheduled for 14:00 UTC. Stress is extreme, but the forecast does not assume release outcomes; Tail stays WATCH unless post-release price discovery becomes persistently one-way.

The first post-release hour remains upper-WATCH conditionally. Tail would be most sensitive to repeated extension after failed retracements and aligned rates, oil, breadth and technology rather than to surprise magnitude alone.
drivers: Conditional cross-asset alignment after the data cluster

forecast.analysis: If the initial U.S. data reaction becomes more two-sided, conditional Tail eases while Stress remains extreme. Continued extreme-holding with shallow pullbacks would prevent that normalization.

Conditional Tail declines if afternoon trade shows range re-entry and volatility decay. A delayed second leg would become relevant only if fresh directional evidence and cross-asset confirmation emerge.
Late afternoon remains WATCH under orderly rotation. Persistent directional extension into the final two cash hours would be the principal condition for renewed Tail escalation.
Power-hour proximity lifts conditional Tail modestly. A one-way closing drive with shallow pullbacks would matter; a balanced auction and range overlap would keep the path within WATCH.
The final cash-session hour stays WATCH conditionally. Tail eases if closing flows remain two-sided, while a sustained extreme close would leave more overnight continuation risk.
drivers: Extreme close versus two-sided final-hour flow

forecast.analysis: After the U.S. cash close, conditional Tail falls if price discovery stabilizes. Geopolitical headlines remain capable of creating gaps, but headline risk alone does not establish a no-retracement path.
CME's daily maintenance interval interrupts continuous price discovery during this hour. Conditional Tail stays WATCH because the next reopen can gap, while no unobserved price path is assumed.
At the Globex reopen, conditional Tail remains WATCH until the new session establishes structure. A gap that promptly retraces would be less concerning than a gap followed by repeated extension.

Early in the next overnight session, conditional Tail sits at the lower WATCH boundary if trade is two-sided. Persistent extension across successive pullback attempts would invalidate that assumption.

forecastDetail.comment: Fresh delayed MNQ is lower in a narrow overnight range; Tail is upper-WATCH, not elevated, because persistent one-way structure is not yet verified.
Early-Asia stabilization would ease Tail; fresh lows with shallow rebounds would be the adverse invalidation.
Two-sided Asian trade would lower conditional Tail, while failed retracements would reverse that easing.
Mid-Asia range overlap keeps Tail contained unless price holds an extreme through shallow pullbacks.
Late-Asia Tail remains contained under overlap; oil and rates matter more if Nasdaq direction also becomes persistent.
The Europe handoff modestly raises Tail because breakout acceptance can increase directional efficiency.
